introduction.section1: The Centre-Val de Loire region invites you to discover an exceptional heritage in the heart of France. The region is charming, known for its famous Loire Valley châteaux. From Chambord to Chenonceau, via Amboise, Blois and Tours, set off to discover a region rich in history.
introduction.section2: Join us to discover the Centre-Val de Loire.
